motion.name: project-switch
motion.purpose: Top-down reveal when the featured project changes; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto

components.name: Featured project selector
components.description: A native pressed button selects the project shown on the stage.
components.css: .project-selector { font: 400 16px Gabarito, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffd45c; color: #34103d; cursor: pointer; } .project-selector:hover { border-color: currentColor; } .project-selector:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #43104f; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: A work-first interface stages software demonstrations as the main event. A mulberry programme rail frames the large projection; vivid caption floors and pale-lavender pauses create a flat, graphic theatre rather than a generic portfolio grid. The system is a reusable template: project and biography content remains editable sample material.
keyCharacteristics: Featured project owns the first view; supporting story follows.
Full mulberry, lavender, gold, lilac, and apricot palette; dark and light themes.
Flat projection/programme language with restrained 4px controls.
dos: Do lead with the selected project and keep the programme rail at 236px on wide screens.
Do preserve native button, select, and anchor interactions with visible keyboard focus.
Do keep the stage flat and apply the reduced-motion override.
donts: Don't promote demo employers, projects, metrics, or links as verified personal claims.
Don't replace the projection-led opening with a name-first gradient hero or interchangeable card grid.
Don't add shadows as a default depth treatment.
